name: run4-tools-reasoning
description: Seed v4 run4 o1: tool use (wiki_search, calculator, read_file, glaive functions), step-by-step reasoning (gsm8k/calc), instructions. Trained 2 h on the tiny100m tool/reasoning corpus.
author: colby

rehearsal.selection: per-sequence organ gap: score = (loss without organ - loss with organ) + 0.5 * loss with organ, masked to the organ's target tokens; only sequences where the organ helps (gap > 0); garbage filter = loss-with-organ above the running 98th percentile is dropped; near-duplicates (MinHash of token 3-grams, >= 0.8 similar) keep only the higher score; coverage = 8 difficulty strata (running score quantiles) with equal quotas; inside a stratum a weighted reservoir (A-Res key u^(1/score)) decides who stays
rehearsal.data_provenance: run4 training data (tiny100m corpus): wiki_tool, calc, gsm8k, tools_misc, glaive, instruct
rehearsal.note: built at harvest from run4 task transcripts (T=1024)

training.data: tiny100m corpus: wiki_tool, glaive, instruct, calc, tools_misc, gsm8k
